name: City Streets & Market
description: Cobbled town district with shopfronts, market stalls and narrow alleys.
palette: grey cobble, painted shutters, canvas awning cream, soot-stained plaster
lighting: bright overcast daylight, deep shade in the alleys, lantern warmth in doorways
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, carefully shaded volumetric detail, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: grey cobblestone paving worn smooth down the middle, gutters running with rainwater
materials: A fantasy city district seen from above. Cobbled streets worn smooth down their centres with open gutters at the sides, roofless shops and townhouses of plaster and timber framing showing counters, shelves, tables and hearths inside, market stalls under striped canvas awnings, stacked crates and barrels against the walls, a handcart and a loaded wagon, painted signboards lying flat against the house fronts without any lettering on them, iron street lamps, a stone fountain basin, narrow alleys running back between the buildings.
boundary: the flat rooftops of the surrounding buildings packed edge to edge, with no way between them
